Data.String: STERILE BOUNDARY: spec break at the X-101 outlet; downstream sterile class SS316L, orbital-welded, drainable (D-020).
E-101: sterile side above raw side by booster P-108A/B; PDT-1028 (sterile out minus raw in) low diverts (D-015).
Divert (C&E I-101): TT-1023/1024 < 411 K or PDT-1028 low: US-1025 closes XV-1025A, UY-1025 opens XV-1025B.
Before each campaign: re-sterilised on once-through water (XV-1034), 413 K, 30 min, to wastewater (XV-1032).
No hot standby and no water into V-101 (D-015). Pumps: A duty, B spare.
pnb plants & bytes GmbH, Aachen, Germany
